description: A stocky yellow-brown shark with a short, broad, flattened snout and a pale yellowish belly, which camouflages it over sandy bottoms. Its two dorsal fins are almost the same size, which separates it from the bull shark. It haunts shallow reefs, mangroves and bays of the Atlantic and eastern Pacific, where pups spend their first years in sheltered nurseries.
eats: Bony fish, crustaceans, rays and small sharks
